description: This file defines the LogFragment class, which is a UI fragment that contains a LogView and manages displaying logs within an Android app. It sets up the view hierarchy, styles, and scrolling behavior for log output.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment subclass that displays a scrollable log view, handles view initialization, styling, and auto-scrolling to the bottom on log updates.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Builds and returns the main view hierarchy containing a ScrollView with a LogView inside.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Lifecycle method that inflates views, sets up text change listener for auto-scrolling, and returns the fragment's main view.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Returns the LogView instance used within the fragment.
